parts.text: 所有大文本右下角也有字数统计，比如10/200

You want every large-text (textarea) to show a **char counter at bottom-right** like "10/200". Currently the ref8443 textareas have `maxlength=200` but no counter. Let me check existing counter infrastructure and the textarea markup.

tool_input.command: cd "D:\repository\苏住房防汛C端"; git branch --show-current; git status --short; Write-Output "=== ref-textarea usages in Ref8443Inspection ==="; Select-String -Path src/components/flood/Ref8443Inspection.vue -Pattern "ref-textarea|textarea-wrap|field-count|textarea-count" | ForEach-Object { "L"+$_.LineNumber+": "+$_.Line.Trim() }; Write-Output "=== existing counter css ==="; Select-String -Path src/styles/ref8443.css -Pattern "textarea-count|textarea-wrap|field-count" | ForEach-Object { "L"+$_.LineNumber+": "+$_.Line.Trim() }
